info.title: Hilom API
info.description: Hilom at Aruga: healing and care, in one hospital system.

get.summary: Issue the XSRF-TOKEN cookie

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
Create a patient portal account and sign in
End the current session

get.summary: The signed-in user and their permissions
Every permission and the scopes it can be granted with
Users, paged, with search and status filter

post.summary: Create a user with a temporary password and roles
Block sign-in and end the user's sessions
Clear a lockout after too many wrong passwords

get.summary: The audit log, newest first, with filters
The audit event catalog, for filters
Other entries from the same request as this one
The filtered log as CSV (recorded as access.audit.exported)
Check the hash chain and report the first entry altered directly in the database
Wards with capacity (active beds), sorted by code
A ward and all its beds

post.summary: Take a bed out of service

get.summary: Departments, paged, with search and active filter

post.summary: Hide from pickers for new records; existing records keep it

get.summary: Positions, paged, with search and active filter

post.summary: Hide from pickers for new records; existing records keep it

get.summary: Specializations, paged, with search and active filter

post.summary: Hide from pickers for new records; existing records keep it

get.summary: Employees in the caller's scope, paged, with search and filters
One employee's profile; 404 when outside the caller's scope

post.summary: Mark active, on leave, or separated

get.summary: Invites sent to an employee, newest first

post.summary: Email an invite to set a password; the account gets the chosen roles

get.summary: Shift definitions in roster order. Any signed-in user can read them (rosters, schedules).

post.summary: Hide from the roster for new entries; existing entries keep it

get.summary: Ward assignments in the caller's scope (all, my wards today, or my own), newest first

post.summary: Assign an employee to a ward from a date. One ward at a time: overlaps return 409.
Set the last day on the ward

get.summary: Wards whose roster the caller can open (all active wards, or their wards today)
A ward's staff and entries for up to 31 days (default: this week, Monday to Sunday)
The signed-in user's own duty days

post.summary: Put someone on a shift. One shift per day, on a ward they're assigned to that day.

get.summary: Swaps you asked for or that are aimed at you, newest first
Swaps on wards you approve for (default: waiting for approval), soonest shift first
Colleagues' upcoming shifts on the same ward that could be swapped for one of yours

post.summary: Exchange the two shifts, after re-checking assignments and one shift per day
Who an invite link is for, or why it no longer works
Set a password, create the account and link it to the employee

get.summary: Patients in the caller's scope, paged, searchable by name, MRN and date of birth

post.summary: Register a patient; the MRN is generated

get.summary: One patient's demographics; 404 when outside the caller's scope. Logged as a record view.
Who viewed or changed this patient's records, newest first (from the audit log)
Portal accounts linked to a patient, with history
The portal user's own links and requests

post.summary: Ask to be linked to a patient, described as the requester knows them

get.summary: Links by status; pending (the review queue, oldest first) by default

post.summary: Match a pending request to a patient and activate it

put.summary: Change can_book / can_view_records on an active link

post.summary: End an active link; access ends on the account's next request

get.summary: All of a patient's allergy entries: active ones first, most severe first, then history. Logged as a record view.

post.summary: Mark an active entry resolved, or entered in error (with a reason)

get.summary: Physicians whose availability the caller may manage: everyone, or only themselves
A physician's slots between two hospital dates (inclusive, up to 62 days)

post.summary: Publish slots from a weekly pattern; slots overlapping open ones are skipped

get.summary: Physicians who take appointments, optionally of one specialization
Free slots (open, upcoming, not booked) for up to 14 days; no patient data

post.summary: Book a free slot for a patient; it waits for the physician to confirm

get.summary: Appointments in the caller's reach between hospital dates (default: today), optionally by physician and status
Appointments of the patients linked to the portal user: upcoming and the last 180 days

post.summary: Turn a request down with a reason; frees the slot
Cancel a requested or confirmed appointment before it starts; frees the slot
Mark a confirmed appointment as a no-show, once its time has started
Check a patient in for a confirmed appointment today; opens an outpatient encounter

get.summary: Encounters in the caller's reach, newest first, optionally one patient's or by status
One encounter; 404 when outside the caller's scope. Logged as a record view.

put.summary: Change the chief complaint and diagnosis summary of an open encounter

post.summary: End an open clinic visit; its appointment becomes completed. A ward stay ends by discharge instead.

get.summary: The encounter's vital signs, newest first, each value flagged against the ranges. Logged as a view of the encounter.

post.summary: Record a set of vital signs on an open encounter; at least one measurement
Void a set of vital signs entered in error, with a reason; it stays in the list, struck through

get.summary: The encounter's notes, newest first, voided ones included. Logged as a view of the encounter.

post.summary: Write a note on an open encounter: assessment, progress, nursing or diet

put.summary: The author edits their note within 24 hours of writing it

post.summary: Write a correction that replaces a note; the original is voided with the reason. Needs clinical.records.void on the original too.
Void a note entered in error, with a reason; it stays in the list, struck through

get.summary: The encounter's physician orders, newest first, discontinued ones included. Logged as a view of the encounter.

post.summary: A physician writes a medication, laboratory, diet, nursing or other order on an open encounter; medication orders need name, dose, route and frequency
Discontinue an active order, with a reason; it stays in the list

get.summary: The MAR: the encounter's medication orders, active first, each with its doses newest first and the allergies its name matches. Logged as a view of the encounter.

post.summary: Record a dose of an active medication order as given (with the dose) or held, refused or not available (with the reason); confirm the allergy check when the patient has active allergies
Void a dose entered in error, with a reason; it stays on the record, struck through
Admit a patient into a free bed, from a clinic visit or directly; opens an inpatient encounter

get.summary: Active beds in active wards with nobody in them, grouped by ward
Current physicians on staff, to choose a stay's attending physician
Free beds to move this stay's patient to, grouped by ward; 404 when the stay is outside the caller's transfer scope

post.summary: Move an admitted patient to another free bed, with a reason; closes the current bed assignment and opens the next
Discharge a patient with a disposition and a discharge summary note; frees the bed and closes the stay

get.summary: The ward board: every bed of the wards in the caller's reach, who is in it, and their allergy and critical-vitals flags
A linked patient's visit and discharge summaries, vital signs and appointments, through an active link with can_view_records; 404 otherwise. Logged as a view of the patient's record.
Normal and critical ranges the API flags vital signs against
